itens.trecho: The first 2 seasons are some of the all-time great television seasons, with several wonderful original characters and great themes that range from mentorship to camaraderie to romance to standing up for what you know is right among several others, and all the highs and lows that come with all of the above.

I started watching this show as someone who doesn't care at all about football (soccer) and had no expectations for the series. Season 1 starts off slow and the Ted Lasso character is a bit annoying at first, but about halfway through the first season it all really started to click for me and season 2 was just fantastic.

Absolutely fantastic, really not in to football so started watching with some reluctance but honestly the best series I’ve seen in a long while with every episode delivering a real feel good factor with every episode! Can’t recommend enough!
